items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Charlie Owens came from Boston and played the other alto book. So I played lead alto, Charlie Owens played second alto

ctx.x: ’65, ’66. So when I came on the band the tenor player was Jay Corre. There was Bobby Porcelli was the other alto player when I came on, and oh boy I forget the baritone player’s name. Bobby Shew was there and shortly after that Chuck Findley came on. As I stayed Jay Corre left, Don Menza took his place. Don was there for a while. Charlie Owens came from Boston and played the other alto book. So I played lead alto, Charlie Owens played second alto, Don Menza played tenor, Pat LaBarbara was there, and Joe Calo…
For sure, and it’s all on record too.
